title: Chemocompetent Cells of Vibrio natriegens Preparation
author: Tobias Hensel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pt9dnr6
materials: All subsequent steps are performed at room temperature!
Thow an aliquot of chemocompetent Vn (Weinstock)
Plate out on LB with 2.5% NaCl

steps.title: Prepare BHI‑v2 growth medium
steps.instruction: Make 150 mL of Brain‑Heart‑Infusion (BHI) broth supplemented with v2 salts: add 37 g/L BHI, 204 mM NaCl, 4.2 mM KCl, 23.14 mM MgCl₂, 55 mM MnCl₂, 15 mM CaCl₂, 250 mM KCl, 10 mM PIPES and 7 % (v/v) DMSO; then add 1.5 mL storage buffer, 35 mL MgCl₂ (100 mM), 30 mL CaCl₂ (100 mM), 15 mL MnCl₂ (555 mM), 15 mL KCl (1 M), 15 mL PIPES (100 mM) and 120 µL specialty DMSO. Mix thoroughly and sterilize.

steps.title: Inoculate and grow culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 150 mL of the prepared BHI‑v2 medium directly from a glycerol stock of Vibrio natriegens in an Erlenmeyer flask; incubate at 30 °C with shaking at 200 rpm until the culture reaches an optical density at 600 nm of 0.4.

steps.title: First harvest and MgCl₂ wash
steps.instruction: Split the culture into three 50 mL conical tubes and centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min; carefully discard the supernatant and gently resuspend each pellet in 5 mL MgCl₂ (100 mM).

steps.title: Combine and second MgCl₂ wash
steps.instruction: Combine the three resuspended pellets into a single 50 mL conical tube, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and gently resuspend the pellet in 20 mL MgCl₂ (100 mM).

steps.title: CaCl₂ wash and incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 3000 × g for 4 min, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 30 mL CaCl₂ (100 mM), and incubate at room temperature for 40 min.

steps.title: Final wash and storage buffer resuspension
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 4 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the cells in 1.5 mL transformation storage buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot, freeze and store cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot the resuspended cells into chilled tubes, flash‑freeze them in a liquid‑nitrogen bath, and store at –80 °C until needed.

steps.title: Transform with pYTK plasmid
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of plasmid pYTK to an aliquot of the chemocompetent V. natriegens cells, then add 800 µL Brain‑Heart‑Infusion medium and proceed with the chosen transformation protocol.
